meta.name: pdf
meta.description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to do anything with PDF files. This includes reading or extracting text/tables from PDFs, combining or merging multiple PDFs into one, splitting PDFs apart, rotating pages, adding watermarks, creating new PDFs, filling PDF forms, encrypting/decrypting PDFs, extracting images, and OCR on scanned PDFs to make them searchable. If the user mentions a .pdf file or asks to produce one, use this skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对 PDF 文件进行读取、合并、拆分、编辑、加密等操作
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要处理 PDF 文件的各种操作
copy.tagline_en: Read, merge, split, edit, and encrypt PDF files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently need to perform various operations on PDF files

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 可以使用 Python 库和命令行工具处理 PDF 文件:读取和提取文本/表格、合并/拆分、旋转页面、添加水印、创建新 PDF、填写表单、加密/解密、提取图片,以及对扫描件进行 OCR 以使其可搜索。
howto.when: 当用户提到 .pdf 文件、要求生成 PDF,或提出与 PDF 相关的任何操作(如读取、合并、加密)时触发。

say.text: 把这两个 PDF 合并成一个文件
say.note: 将调用合并功能生成新 PDF。

say.text: 从这份 PDF 里提取表格并导出到 Excel
say.note: 会使用 pdfplumber 提取表格。

say.text: 给这个 PDF 加上密码保护
say.note: 会用 pypdf 加密文件。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can process PDF files using Python libraries and CLI tools: read and extract text/tables, merge, split, rotate pages, add watermarks, create new PDFs, fill forms, encrypt/decrypt, extract images, and OCR scanned PDFs to make them searchable.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions a .pdf file, asks to produce one, or requests any PDF-related operation such as reading, merging, or encrypting.

say_en.text: Merge these two PDFs into one file.
say_en.note: Will merge the pages using pypdf.

say_en.text: Extract tables from this PDF and export them to Excel.
say_en.note: Will use pdfplumber for table extraction.

say_en.text: Add a password to this PDF.
say_en.note: Will encrypt the file with pypdf.
